## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run format:check`, `npm run lint`, `npm run typecheck`, `npm test`, `npm run build` pass
- [ ] Each commit holds at most 300 changes and 5 files
- [ ] New numbers live in `src/constants` or `Config`; new paths in `ApiRoutes`
- [ ] A schema change has a new migration (never an edited one)
- [ ] `docs/openapi.json` regenerated (`npm run openapi`) when a route or schema changed
- [ ] Docs under `docs/feature-docs` updated
